name: vLLM
summary: Python LLM inference and serving engine.
useful_for: Later GPU-hosted open-weight batch or tool-call workloads.
limitation: Infrastructure, not an assistant or Mac desktop runtime.

name: SGLang
summary: Open-weight model serving and programming runtime.
useful_for: Evaluate alongside vLLM if a future GPU service is justified.
limitation: Not a personal-assistant UI or local Mac-first default.

name: llama.cpp
summary: C/C++ inference project with a server surface for local GGUF models.
useful_for: Optional offline classification, extraction, or fallback experiments.
limitation: Model quality, memory fit and tool reliability must be evaluated per model; it is not orchestration.

name: Ollama
summary: Local open-model runtime with a simple developer-facing product surface.
useful_for: Optional local small-model experiments on Mac, isolated from subscription agent work.
limitation: A runtime alone does not supply safe tools, memory, or task recovery.

name: MLX LM
summary: Apple MLX package for text generation and fine-tuning on Apple silicon.
useful_for: Mac-first controlled experiments for small local jobs.
limitation: Python package, not an end-user assistant or provider abstraction.

name: Text Generation Inference
summary: Hugging Face text-generation server.
useful_for: Historical/reference serving architecture only.
limitation: Its README says maintenance mode and recommends vLLM, SGLang or local engines for new use.

name: LiteLLM
summary: Self-hostable OpenAI-format model gateway.
useful_for: A later explicit routing boundary across budgeted APIs and local models.
limitation: Core is MIT but enterprise directory has a separate licence; do not introduce it ahead of a measured multi-provider need.

name: Xinference
summary: Unified serving API for open-source language, speech and multimodal models.
useful_for: Compare if multiple local model modalities become a current need.
limitation: Operating a multi-model service adds hardware and lifecycle work.

name: LocalAI
summary: Local AI engine for multiple model modalities.
useful_for: Reference for optional self-hosted multimodal experiments.
limitation: Broad scope means substantial configuration and model operations; not a shortcut to a reliable assistant.

name: LocalAGI
summary: Local-first AI project with a Web UI and integrations.
useful_for: Reference for local integration ideas.
limitation: It is a separate assistant product, not a support component to embed by default.

name: TensorRT-LLM
summary: NVIDIA-optimised LLM and visual-generation inference runtime.
useful_for: Future PC/NVIDIA benchmark candidate only.
limitation: NVIDIA/CUDA specific and therefore not the Mac-first path.

name: Triton Inference Server
summary: General multi-framework inference server.
useful_for: Reference for a future managed inference tier.
limitation: Server operations are far beyond an initial private Mac assistant.

name: Pipecat
summary: Framework for real-time voice and multimodal agent pipelines.
useful_for: Compare for a future live-voice prototype around a chosen transport/provider.
limitation: It supplies pipeline building blocks, not device authority or durable task orchestration.

name: LiveKit Agents
summary: Framework for realtime multimodal agent applications.
useful_for: Evaluate transport and turn-taking components if building a self-hosted voice layer.
limitation: A separate real-time stack may duplicate provider live capabilities; prove need first.

name: LiveKit Agent Starter React
summary: React/Next.js voice-agent starter for LiveKit Agents.
useful_for: Reference for voice UI states and interruption controls.
limitation: Starter template, not a desktop harness or mobile companion architecture.

name: LiveKit Components JS
summary: JavaScript UI components and hooks for LiveKit realtime apps.
useful_for: Reference voice UI semantics if LiveKit is selected later.
limitation: Ties the UI to the LiveKit stack.

name: Magentic-UI
summary: MIT-licensed agent workspace with React frontend, sessions, browser/task state and tests.
useful_for: Source-level reference for explicit session state, browser takeover feedback and optimistic UI edge cases.
limitation: A complete separate product, so reuse patterns or small independently reviewed portions only.

name: Playwright MCP
summary: MCP server exposing browser automation through Playwright.
useful_for: Reproducible browser test and observation tools with explicit scoped authority.
limitation: Browser-only support infrastructure, not desktop computer use or a visual design system.

name: MCP reference servers
summary: MCP steering-group reference server implementations.
useful_for: Protocol education and narrowly scoped server patterns.
limitation: README explicitly says these examples are educational, not production-ready; licensing is in transition.

name: FastMCP TypeScript
summary: TypeScript MCP-server framework.
useful_for: Historical/reference TypeScript MCP server ergonomics.
limitation: README states it supports legacy handshake MCP revisions only, not the current stateless specification.

name: FastMCP Python
summary: Python framework for building MCP servers; canonical successor of jlowin/fastmcp redirect.
useful_for: Reference only if a Python MCP server becomes a current requirement.
limitation: Avoid a framework choice until a real server is required; verify exact current MCP compatibility at implementation time.

name: Motion
summary: JavaScript, React and Vue animation library with extensive test fixtures.
useful_for: Subtle task-card, layout and permission-state transitions.
limitation: Animation needs a reduced-motion path and must never conceal task state.

name: XYFlow
summary: React and Svelte libraries for node-based interfaces.
useful_for: Optional inspectable task/provenance graph after the core receipt rail is proven.
limitation: Graphs quickly become decorative and unreadable for ordinary work; not a default canvas.

name: React Three Fiber
summary: React renderer for Three.js scenes.
useful_for: A contained high-end visual experiment such as a one-off assistant presence scene.
limitation: WebGL has performance, accessibility and product-focus costs; keep out of the working surface.

name: Drei
summary: Reusable helpers and abstractions for React Three Fiber.
useful_for: Reference helper catalogue if a deliberately small R3F visual is selected.
limitation: Adds no business value on its own and inherits the 3D UI risks.

name: react-spring
summary: Spring-physics-first animation library.
useful_for: Compare motion feel for a few tactile interactions.
limitation: Choose one animation system per surface; do not layer it with Motion without a concrete need.

name: Magic UI
summary: MIT visual component library with demos.
useful_for: Inspiration or individually reviewed presentation components.
limitation: Avoid adopting a component-library aesthetic wholesale in a dense workbench.

name: React Bits
summary: Animated React components and backgrounds with public demos.
useful_for: Pattern inspiration only, such as a calm status presence experiment.
limitation: Repository is MIT plus Commons Clause: do not copy or ship its code/assets without a separate licence review; several effects continuously render WebGL/canvas.

name: egui
summary: Immediate-mode Rust GUI library.
useful_for: Reference for fast native diagnostic or control surfaces if React/WebView proves unsuitable in a measured area.
limitation: A new UI paradigm would complicate visual consistency and migration.

name: Tauri
summary: Rust desktop framework using system WebViews and a frontend chosen by the app.
useful_for: Leading candidate to replace Electron while retaining a React UI and moving measured native work into Rust.
limitation: It is not inherently lower memory for a given app; migration must benchmark lifecycle, terminal I/O, WebView and recovery on target hardware.
